adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`, which evaluate to the stringified Zod objects (likely the same key such as "[object Object]"), so the latter overwrites the former and does not implement the intended “any numeric expiry field” logic. Additionally, `z.object(...)` strips unknown keys by default, so when the minimum schema path is used (when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), fields like `expiry_date`, `refresh_token`, `instance_url`, etc. will be dropped. The subsequent mutation `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` will then overwrite real refresh tokens when callers spread/assign `data` back into stored credentials (e.g., Office365 does `{...o365AuthCredentials, ...tokenResponse.data}`), causing credential corruption/data loss.
